verdict.reason: The source never names AWS or its authors as the paper's affiliation, so that attribution is unsupported. The date (Submitted 3 Aug 2026) and findings are in the source: OCR+Image gives "more accurate confidence estimates" and calibration ranges "from near-perfect to severely overconfident". The claim leaves out that the second half of that range is severe overconfidence and that OCR+Image was compared across only three modalities, but the affiliation is the clear unsupported detail.
